items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Who? ... [INTERVIEWER] Mercer Ellington's book; this book, 'Duke Ellington In Person', the one that Mercer wrote. [INTERVIEWEE] Mercer's book?

ctx.x: reed section, and almost ignored the brass section. Do you think that's right?

I don't know; maybe when Mercer was himself in the brass section -- but when we had a good brass section, I never heard him squawking about the brass section or anything like that, and paid attention to the reed section.
Uh huh. Did you tell Mercer that his father always wanted the trombones to play loud? Do you think ..
